\text{[Equation 2: 비등확률 (Claude Shannon, 가중평균)]}\quad H = \sum_{i=1}^{N} p_i \log_2\left(\frac{1}{p_i}\right) = -\sum_{i=1}^{N} p_i \log_2 p_i\;\text{[bits]}

\begin{aligned}
              H(X) &= \sum_i P(X_i)\log_2\frac{1}{P(X_i)}, \qquad H(Y) = \sum_j P(Y_j)\log_2\frac{1}{P(Y_j)} \\
              H(X \cup Y) &= H(X,Y) = \sum_i \sum_j p_{ij} \log_2\frac{1}{p_{ij}} \quad (\text{모든 결합 확률 } p_{ij}\text{의 가중평균}) \\
              \text{Transmitted Information: }\; H(X \cap Y) &= T(X,Y) = H(X) + H(Y) - H(X \cup Y) \quad (\text{클수록 좋음: larger the better}) \\
              \text{Equivocation (miss): }\; H(X|Y) &= H(X) - H(X \cap Y) = H(X \cup Y) - H(Y) \quad (\text{작을수록 좋음: smaller the better}) \\
              \text{Noise (false): }\; H(Y|X) &= H(Y) - H(X \cap Y) = H(X \cup Y) - H(X) \quad (\text{작을수록 좋음: smaller the better})
              \end{aligned}
